title: RSI2: Five In, Zero Through. The Later Prices Stayed Locked.
first_spoken_sentence: The SPY RSI2 screen stopped five candidates before the later prices opened.
audience: A curious beginner who can read a number but does not yet know why a later block has to be sealed.
delivery_promise: Teach the evidence boundary in the real SPY and Dow receipts, with inequalities, units, and a practical freeze-before-retest worksheet.

provider_route.note: No TTS, image, video, account, credit, or provider action is authorized at candidate stage.

visual_thesis.primary_mechanism: freeze selection, seal the later-price chamber, and let the separate Dow lane cross it
visual_thesis.evidence_surface: deterministic bars, gates, operators, units, and branch state
visual_thesis.context_surface: small atlas marks only; no generated media is used as evidence
visual_thesis.anti_pattern: no repeated black-and-gold dashboard cards; no provenance labels inside lesson graphics
visual_thesis.first_shot: SPY candidates stop at a sealed vertical door while the thumbnail's three-element idea is visible immediately

scope_boundaries: SPY is a stock D1 intake branch and does not receive a holdout result in this receipt.
Dow is a separate futures branch and supplies the worked out-of-sample contrast.
The lesson ends with fill timing and trading-hours questions; it does not disclose the later timing census.
